description: Create (or fetch) a post's read-only review link that anyone can open without signing in — for client approval outside the app. Returns { shareToken, url, created }. regenerate=true mints a new link and kills the old one. Pro and Business only: on the single-seat Free and Lifetime plans this answers 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with the plan and an upgrade hint. Use this when the user wants a link a client or colleague can open to review a post without an account.

regenerate.description: Mint a new token, invalidating the previous link.

name: share_post
title: Create post review link
